name: hybrid_regret_construction_oropt_refine
thought: Combines farthest-first seed selection, regret-based customer assignment to seeds, cheapest insertion route construction, and local search with inter-route relocate/swap from the longest route plus intra-route Or-opt. Adds a ruin-recreate step that removes a subset of customers from the longest route and reinserts them with cheapest insertion to escape local optima. Deterministic tie-breaking by smaller index. All loops bounded by instance size.
